title: RL and Policy Learning Workflows (High Level)
description: Reinforcement Learning (RL) and policy learning are powerful paradigms for training robots to perform complex tasks through trial and error. This section provides an overview of high-level workflows for applying RL and policy learning in robotics, often leveraging simulation environments like Isaac Sim and Isaac Gym.
